title: The President’s Address
version: Journal of the Royal Microscopical Society 7(2), April 1887, pp. 185–199; annual meeting 9 February 1887. Internet Archive full-volume OCR.
lineage: Contemporary tester and instrument recipient reporting observations and a Society exhibition. It is not a maker’s recipe record; his qualitative comparisons are kept within their equipment and test scope.

passages.note: Date of address, distinguished from April journal issue.
Read Jena materials and optical system, receipt of first Zeiss objective, paired tests, eyepiece substitutions, later complete series and independently recorded Mayall judgments.

passages.quote: on a formula of their own
passages.note: Read glass receipt by English opticians, Powell and Lealand objective, Abbe-plan eyepieces, November exhibition and Dallinger’s later possession.
